jobs.occupation: Business Control and Operations Specialist - Brussels - Banking
jobs.description:
Our client is an innovative financial services institution operating in the Belgian market. Through a strong customer-centric and digital approach, they provide a range of financial solutions while maintaining a strong focus on operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement.

To support their continued growth, they are currently looking for a Business Support & Operations Specialis to join their team in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

• Own and oversee critical operational processes and control frameworks
• Act as the escalation point for complex operational cases and policy-related decisions
• Ensure compliance with internal procedures, AML/KYC, GDPR and regulatory requirements
• Manage sensitive customer and account-related operations
• Prepare and analyse KPI, SLA and regulatory reporting
• Drive process improvement initiatives and operational excellence
• Participate in audits, investigations and risk mitigation activities
• Support the implementation of new products, systems and operational changes
• Develop procedures and provide training to operational teams

• Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent through experience
• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience within banking, financial services, insurance, or another highly regulated environment
• Solid understanding of retail banking operations and customer lifecycle processes
• Experience in AML/KYC, compliance, operational risk management, or process governance
• Strong analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail
• Experience with reporting, performance monitoring, and data analysis
• Knowledge of CRM systems, workflow tools, and financial services operations
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
• Hands-on, proactive, and solution-oriented approach
• Ability to manage complex cases while balancing regulatory requirements and customer experience
• Fluency in Dutch or French with professional proficiency in Dutch or French and English

Our client is an international company combining a corporate, international culture with a strong focus on efficiency, quality, and innovation. They support business operations through technology-driven solutions and continuous improvement of internal processes.

The environment is collaborative and evolving, offering employees the opportunity to grow and develop within the company. The company is located in Brussels and is easily accessible with public transport.

Jobomschrijving

As L&D HR Officer, you'll be responsible for:

• Coordinate, organize, and deliver training sessions
• Maintain & update the training catalogue
• Identify development needs and manage relationships with external training providers
• Ensure accurate HR data management and documentation (training records, performance data, job files)
• Coordinate and manage the performance management cycle (ensuring timely completion of objectives setting and reviews)
• Act as key user of HR tools providing user support and driving adoption across the organization
• Maintain and update job descriptions, job grading, and organizational charts
• Support career development initiatives
• Contribute and support HR activities when needed

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in HR, training, education, or a related field
• Fluent in English, with a good command of French or Dutch
• First experience in HR, HR Development, Learning & Development, or a similar role (junior profiles welcome)
• Dynamic, proactive, and able to convince stakeholders to adopt new tools and processes
• Strong organizational skills with a structured and detail-oriented mindset
• Curious and hands-on, with a willingness to learn and take ownership of HR systems and tools
• Strong communication skills with the ability to interact at all levels of the organization

Our client is a leading international manufacturing company with a strong presence across Europe and beyond.

Jobomschrijving

Throughout the program, you will gain a comprehensive understanding of how a large international organization serves customers across multiple markets and drives commercial performance through data, technology, and process excellence.

• Three rotations of 9-12 months across different Commercial Excellence and Operations functions
• Exposure to multiple countries within an international business environment
• Cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Business Leadership teams
• Direct interaction with senior management and key decision-makers
• Ownership of meaningful projects with visible business impact
• Structured learning and development curriculum focused on business excellence, digital transformation, and leadership
• Dedicated support from a mentor and buddy from the start of the program

What You Will LearnDuring the program, you will build expertise in:

• Commercial strategy and performance management
• Business analytics and data-driven decision-making
• Digital transformation and technology-enabled processes
• Process optimization and continuous improvement
• Stakeholder management and effective communication
• Leadership, professional development, and change management

You will work alongside experienced professionals who are committed to helping you successfully transition from academia into a thriving international career.

We are seeking curious, analytical, and ambitious individuals who are eager to challenge conventional thinking and make a real impact.

Requirements

• Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Management, or a related field
• Recent graduate or expected graduation from 2026 onwards
• Initial professional experience through internships, student jobs, or a first role is an asset
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Passion for technology, digital innovation, and business transformation
• Proactive mindset with the confidence to challenge the status quo
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• Lead workshops to gather, challenge, and translate business requirements into S2P solutions.
• Configure and implement Ivalua solutions aligned with client procurement and finance processes.
• Coordinate and align stakeholders across Procurement, Finance, and IT functions.
• Analyze procurement processes, spend data, and governance frameworks to identify improvement opportunities.
• Drive data migration, data quality, testing, and solution validation activities.

Our client is a well-established international organisation with a strong reputation for operational excellence and a people-focused culture. 

To strengthen its local IT presence in Belgium, our client is looking for a service-oriented IT professional who enjoys working in a collaborative and multicultural environment. The organisation promotes knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and professional development while offering employees the opportunity to work closely with both local and international teams.

Jobomschrijving

As an IT Support (L2), your responsibilities will include:

• Providing first and second-line IT support to end users.
• Managing incidents, service requests, and technical queries in line with established processes and service level agreements.
• Troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and Microsoft 365-related issues.
• Acting as the primary local IT point of contact for employees based in Belgium.
• Logging, tracking, documenting, and resolving tickets using the company's IT Service Management platform.
• Collaborating with international IT teams, vendors, and specialist support teams to resolve complex issues.
• Monitoring IT systems and escalating recurring or critical issues when required.
• Supporting IT projects, deployments, upgrades, and infrastructure changes.
• Managing employee onboarding and offboarding activities, including hardware preparation, account setup, and access management.
• Supporting meeting room technology, printers, audiovisual equipment, and local IT infrastructure.
• Creating and maintaining user documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational procedures.
• Identifying opportunities to improve processes, enhance service quality, and optimise the overall user experience.

The successful candidate will have:

• At least 2/3 years of experience in an IT Support, Service Desk, or End User Support role.
• Fluency in English & Dutch. French is a plus. 
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows environments, end-user computing, networking fundamentals, and IT security best practices.
• Experience managing incidents, service requests, and change-related activities.
• Hands-on experience with Active Directory and Microsoft 365 user administration.
• Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to resolve technical issues independently.
• Strong customer service and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
• A structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach to work.
• The ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple requests in a fast-paced environment.

ITIL, Microsoft, or other relevant certifications would be considered an advantage.

On a personal level, you are recognised for your customer-centric mindset, team spirit, adaptability, and willingness to continuously learn and improve. You enjoy taking ownership, driving improvements, and delivering an outstanding support experience to end users.

As a Sales Manager your responsibilities are:

• Manage and grow key accounts, ensuring long-term relationships with clients.

Profile We're Looking For

Jobomschrijving

As a Finance Administrator your responsibilities are:

• Provide administrative support as needed
• Manage accounts payable and ensure accurate invoice processing
• Execute payments and liaise with banking partners

A successful Finance Administrator should have:

• Minimum 2-3 years of experience in finance, accounting or administration
• Fluent in English and Dutch or French
• Strong attention to detail and structured way of working

The client is a leading international industrial organization operating in a complex, high-volume manufacturing environment, with a strong focus on operational excellence, continuous improvement, and supply chain performance.

• Lead, coordinate, and monitor day-to-day warehouse and distribution activities, ensuring operational priorities, service levels, inventory accuracy, and delivery requirements are met.

• Proven experience in warehouse and distribution management, ideally within a complex industrial or high-volume operational environment.
• Strong skills in operational planning, stakeholder management, project management, budget control, and continuous improvement.
• Demonstrated leadership and people-management capabilities, with the ability to motivate teams and manage both permanent and temporary workforce populations.
• Fluent English and fluent local language skills, with strong written and verbal communication abilities and a strong focus on operational excellence.

Our client is an European organization.

jobs.occupation: E-commerce & Digital Experience Specialist - Retail sector
jobs.description:
Our client is a fast-growing European player in the health, wellness and retail sector, with a strong presence across Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Italy and Spain.

Founded in 2014, the Group has developed a successful omnichannel business model, combining an extensive network of physical stores with high-performing e-commerce platforms. With more than 200 points of sale and over 2,000 employees, the company is continuing its international growth, driven by innovation, operational excellence and a strong commitment to customer experience.

Joining this organisation means becoming part of a dynamic and entrepreneurial international group where digital transformation and customer-centricity are at the heart of the growth strategy.

Jobomschrijving

As E-commerce & Digital Experience Specialist , you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of the company e-commerce platforms.

Working at the crossroads of e-commerce, digital performance, IT and customer experience, you will monitor platform performance, coordinate incidents, identify opportunities for improvement and contribute to the implementation of new digital functionalities.

Your excellent command of Dutch will be particularly important in ensuring the quality and consistency of the Belgian Dutch-language webshop, from content and translations to the overall customer journey.

Key Responsibilities

• Monitor the daily performance and operational KPIs of the Benelux e-commerce platforms, ensuring a smooth and reliable online customer experience.
• Oversee payment and delivery processes and proactively identify potential issues impacting customer satisfaction or conversion.
• Coordinate incidents with internal stakeholders across E-commerce, IT, Customer Service, Logistics and Project teams, as well as external partners.
• Investigate root causes, recommend corrective actions and drive continuous improvements across processes and tools.
• Take ownership of the quality of the Dutch-language Belgian webshop, reviewing content, translations and the end-to-end customer journey.
• Analyse digital performance, user behaviour and customer data to identify opportunities to improve conversion, usability and overall experience.
• Set up, monitor and analyse A/B tests and translate insights into concrete optimisation initiatives.
• Contribute to the delivery of new digital functionalities, from gathering business requirements and functional analysis through testing and release validation.
• Manage and prioritise the e-commerce backlog in close collaboration with Group Project and IT teams.
• Support the implementation of new marketing, personalisation and digital optimisation tools.
• Collaborate with Benelux and Group teams to share best practices and contribute to the broader international digital roadmap.

• Native or near-native Dutch speaker, with an excellent understanding of the Dutch language and strong attention to linguistic and content quality.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in E-Business, Digital Marketing, Business IT or a related field.
• At least 4 years of experience in e-commerce, digital operations, web operations or a comparable role.
• Strong understanding of e-commerce operations, digital performance and customer journey optimisation.
• Experience in an omnichannel, retail or international environment is highly valued.
• Good command of French and professional proficiency in English.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data and insights into actionable improvements.
• Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Comfortable working across business and technical teams and coordinating multiple stakeholders.
• Experience with tools such as Google Analytics 4, Contentsquare, Heap, Kameleoon, JIRA or similar platforms is a strong advantage.
• Knowledge of e-commerce CMS platforms such as Hybris, as well as HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Google Tag Manager, is a plus.
• Curious, proactive and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership and a genuine interest in digital innovation.
